title: Input of python -m spq.signal --contract 2 (perpetual-futures strategy)
description: The version-1 input (signal-input.schema.json) plus funding, and optionally mark and index, for the perpetuals of the universe. Nothing dated after the last candle's bar-open time may be present: such a value does not exist yet at the decision and the runner refuses the input.

candles.description: exactly the symbols of META['universe'] (spot legs '<SYMBOL>.SPOT' included); closed bars, oldest first, [ts, open, high, low, close, volume]

prefixItems.description: bar-open time: ISO 8601 UTC or epoch seconds

funding.description: exactly the perpetuals of META['universe']; hourly settlements, oldest first: [ts, rate] or [ts, rate, premium]. ts = settlement time (within 60 s of the hour), rate = fraction of notional that longs paid at that settlement (negative: shorts paid). A settlement is attached to the bar that opens at its hour.

mark.description: optional, perpetuals only: [ts, mark price] on bar-open times of the candles

index.description: optional, perpetuals only: [ts, index / oracle price] on bar-open times of the candles

as_of.description: optional; must equal the bar-open time of the last bar supplied
